summary: RPM enterprise topology (each VM 16 GB, 4 CPU, 60 GB, 3000 IOPS): 2 gateway, 2 hub and 2 EDA with colocated Redis, 2 controllers, 1 hop node, 2 execution nodes, external database and external HAProxy. Redis HA needs 6 VMs and cannot be on controller, execution or DB nodes; RPM installs don't support external Redis.
